_note: Per-stock corrections over base_template.json, keyed by NegPy crosstalk profile (the file stem, e.g. kodak_gold_200; NegPy's bundled profiles live in vendor/NegPy/crosstalk/). `negmcp new` applies the entry matching the roll's crosstalk_profile on top of the base. Format: "<profile>": {<flat NegPy key>: value, ...}; {} = the base fits that stock as-is. Reserved entries: "_transparency" = applied to slide rolls (info.txt `process_mode: Transparency`); "_push" = {"<profile>" | "_default": {...}} applied on top when info.txt has a `push:` line (not `push: none`). Keys starting with `_` are notes. Add a stock here only after its look is validated on a real roll.
